items.title: Braelon Allen: Breaks out for 116 yards, TD
items.text:
Allen rushed 24 times for 116 yards and a touchdown while catching one of four targets for no gain in Sunday's 17-12 win over the Browns.

items.title: Matthew Golden: Eclipses century mark in win
items.text:
Golden secured six of seven targets for 123 yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Bears on Sunday. He also returned two punts for 27 yards.
